# go-redis-v9

Deprecated: moved to [github.com/searKing/golang/pkg/log/redislog](../../../../pkg/log/redislog), of which this
module is an alias. Replace

```go
import redis_ "github.com/searKing/golang/third_party/github.com/redis/go-redis-v9"
```

with

```go
import "github.com/searKing/golang/pkg/log/redislog"
```
